name: AI Agent Tools Overview
description: Discover how AI agents use tools to interact with the world and perform actions beyond text generation.

steps.content: Let's explore how AI agents use tools! Tools allow me to do more than just generate text - I can perform actions, retrieve information, and interact with systems.
Explain what AI agent tools are and provide examples. Discuss how tools extend an agent's capabilities beyond language generation. Mention tool schemas, parameters, and execution.

In this transparent agent framework, you can see:
- Which tools are available to the agent
- When a tool is called and with what parameters
- The results returned by each tool
- How the agent uses tool results in its reasoning
List 3-4 example tool types that AI agents commonly use (like web search, file operations, API calls, calculations). For each, briefly explain its purpose.

The transparency of tool usage is crucial for:
✓ Understanding agent behavior
✓ Debugging tool call issues
✓ Auditing agent actions
✓ Building trust in AI systems
Excellent! You now understand how AI agents use tools and why transparent tool execution is important. Ready to explore more advanced topics?
